name: Meat Log Mountain
source:
Meat Log Mountain is a remote lumberjacking town where live only very huge men (of many races: human, dwarf, orc, demon...). The doctor, mister Brown, just died. You're Thaddeus Cub, the new doctor, freshly graduated from the medical academy. As you enter the town, you realize you already have three appointments: Harry (human), Durk (orc) and Demonos (demon)... And they'll become special...

[From [url=http://allthetropes.wikia.com/wiki/Meat_Log_Mountain]All The Tropes Wiki[/url]]
translation:
肉木山是一个偏远的伐木小镇，那里只住着体型巨大的人类（许多种族：人类、矮人、兽人、恶魔……）。医生布朗先生刚刚去世。你是撒迪厄斯·库布，新来的医生，刚从医学院毕业。当你进入城镇时，你意识到你已经有了三个约会：哈利（人类）、德克（兽人）和德莫诺斯（恶魔）……他们会变得特别……

[来自[url=http://allthetropes.wikia.com/wiki/Meat_Log_Mountain]All The Tropes Wiki[/url]]
